i.norm: Verifies that a non-canonical BHSDCodec decoded from an explicit encoding byte (value 116) round-trips correctly through getCodec() and getSpecifier(). Encoding byte 116 tells getCodec() to read two bytes from the stream to construct a BHSDCodec: - First byte (93 = 0x5D): encodes d=1, s=2, b=4 - Second byte (0): encodes h=1 This yields BHSDCodec(4, 1, 2, 1), which is not in the canonical table. getSpecifier() on a non-canonical BHSDCodec emits a 3-element array: [116, (d + 2*s + 8*(b-1)), (h-1)] = [116, 29, 0]
Band-headers stream: first byte encodes BHSDCodec parameters, second byte encodes H. Remaining 7 bytes are unused padding (all zeros).
Value 116 signals an explicit BHSDCodec; getCodec reads 2 bytes from bandHeaderStream.
Confirm that exactly 2 bytes were consumed from the 9-byte stream.
The decoded non-canonical codec round-trips to the 3-element specifier [116, 29, 0].
